tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo'i sgrub thabs gser gyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// grags ldan rnams kyi mgo bo'i gtsug gi nor bu'i dpal// dmar ba'i mdangs bkod shin tu yun ring ma lon 'dra'i// 'phags pa khyod zhabs dag la gus par phyag byas nas// sgrub thabs gser gyi 'phreng bas deng 'dir mchod par bgyi// 'phags pa yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags chen mo/ lakṣ+mī ka ra'i man ngag dpal 'brug pa'i ring lugs las 'ongs pa bzhin bsgrub par 'dod pas/ 'di nyid kyi dbang thob cing bya ba'i rgyud kyi dam tshig la mkhas pas dben zhing bkra shis pa'i sar/ bris sku dgram/ maṇḍal dri bzang pos byugs pa la/ rdul tshon nam/ tshom bu'am/ 'bur du dod pa'i lha'i snang brnyan gsum gang rung legs par bkod/ ji tsam 'byor pa'i mchod pas mdun bdar/ khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma gyon/ stan dri ma med pa'i khar/ padma'i rigs kyi skyil krung bcas/ lus drang por bsrangs nas/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥyig dkar po las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam pa can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen pos mdun du bdar ba/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bltas nas/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*/ dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gus pas dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// zhes mchod nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog/ ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa blang*/

de nas badzra muḥyis tshogs zhing rang gnas su gshegs/ de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyud dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig snyam pa tshad med pa bsgom par bya'o// de nas sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i 'da' las drangs nas/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa la bzhag par bya'o snyam du smon lam gyi sems bskyed nas/ de'i ched du 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di ltar bya ste/ shes rab kyi mig gis phyi rol gyi snang ba la brtags pas ma rig pas bslad pa'i sems nyid phyi rol tu chad pa lta bur snang ba kho na ste/ phyi'i dngos por grub pa ni cung zad kyang med do// de'i phyir khams gsum po 'di dag sems tsam mo// sems de nyid kyang cir yang dmigs su med pa nam mkha' lta bu'o// de bas na phung po khams skye mched kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba sgyu ma lta bu'o snyam du nges nas/ bdag gi de kho na nyid rnam par mi rtog pa la mnyam par bzhag go /de byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di brjod par bya'o// de nas sgyu ma lta bu de nyid kyang rnam pa med pa phyogs thams cad khyab pa de bzhin du bdag gis bsgrub par bya ba'i gsang sngags kyi lha yang de bzhin te/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi snang ba ni/ bdag gi de kho na nyid kyi ye shes snang bar 'dus so snyam nges pas/ chu dang 'o ma bzhin du gnyis su med par cung zad brtag pa ni byang chub kyi sems sam stong pa nyid kyi lha'o// de byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho ྅haṃ/

zhes pa'i sngags brjod par bya'o// de nas stong pa nyid de nyid kun rdzob tu cha shas rdzogs shing dri ma med pa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par gyur pa'i steng du hrīḥtsheg drag dang bcas pa/ mthar/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags yi ge'i rnam par snang bas bskor ba la cung zad blta ba ni yi ge'i lha'o// de nas sngags kyi yi ge'i rang sgra nam mkha'i mtha'i bar du bsgrag pas/ 'phags pa'i tshogs mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus/ dbyer med du gyur/ de ltar bsam pa ni sgra'i lha'o// de nyid las slar yang 'od zer 'phags pa'i gzugs can nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams mchod/ sems can thams cad la reg pas sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzugs dang bcas te slar log rang gi sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la zhugs te gcig tu gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug bsil zer byed pa'i snying po lta bu zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag tu med pas brgyan cing*/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba rgyal ba'i dbang po kun gyi phyag rgya thugs kar gnas pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi g.yas na bgrang 'phreng dang*/ g.yon chu skyes kyi sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ mdzes sdug gi dpyid/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ kunda 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi khongs na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ de ltar bsgom pa ni gzugs kyi lha'o// de nas thal mo sbyar/ gung mo bsgrengs ba'i tshigs gsum pa'i steng du mdzub mo'i rtse mo bzhag mthe bong snyoms par gshibs pa yang tshigs de dang nye bar bkod/ ming med nang du bkug mthe'u chung sbyar ba brkyang ba utpal kha bye ba'i phyag rgya ste/ de bcings/ oṃ mahā su kha badzra sa twa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ

su ra te st+waṃ/ a la la la la hoḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags kyi rgyal po brjod pa de ni phyag rgya'i lha'o// de nas rang gi lha'i 'du shes dang ma bral bar yang dang yang du yid la byed pa la slob pa ni mtshan ma'i lha ste/ de ltar lha rnam pa drug gis bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor bstan to// oṃ badzra re khe hūṃ zhes pas/ bris sku la sogs pa gang du bkram pa'i phyogs de rin po che du ma las byas pa'i sa gzhi gser gyi bye ma brdal ba/ de'i dbus su gru 'dzin gyi ri bo ngos bzhi na rin po che'i them skas/ khor yug tu dpag bsam gyi shing legs par bskrun pa/ rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan stong 'phyang ba/ rgya dang khyon dpag tu med pa padma dang utpal la sogs pa'i me tog gi nags/ sprul pa'i bya dang ri dwags rnam pa mang pos gtams pa/ de'i steng du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi pho brang rin po che'i rgyal po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rgyu las byung ba/ gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis rgyan pa ka ba bzhi zug pa/ bkra ba/ blta na sdug pa/ shin tu rnam par phye ba/ rin po che'i them skas bzhi dang bcas pa'i nang du/ ri'i dbus brtol nas byung ba'i rin po che'i padmo sdong po dang*/ 'dam ma dang*/ ze ba dang*/ snying po nor bu'i rgyan gyis ngom pa med par brgyan pa/ dpag tshad du ma'i khyon can/ zla ba chu shel gyi gdan bting ba mos pas bskyed la/ na ma ārya ba lo ke shwa ra nam sarba thārkhaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo las phan tshun bsnol te g.yas pa'i mthe bos g.yon pa'i mthe bong mnan pa'i phyag rgyas de rnams de bzhin gnas par byin gyis brlab bo// de nas pus mo gnyis btsugs te mchod yon dang bcas pa'i lag pa'i sor mo phan tshun du bsnol nas/ thal mo bkan la/

mdzub mo gnyis gshibs te bsgreng*/ mthe bong gnyis g.yab pa spyan drangs ba'i phyag rgyas mchod yon bsgreng*/ bdug spos bdug cing*/ thugs rjes sems can kun la bye brag med par thugs rjer mdzad pa yi// 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug khyod mchod chu bos yid ni dag byed de// 'bad pa don yod gcig pur mthong nas blta bar re ba bcas gyur pa// sdig 'joms dam bca' bdag la 'bras ldan mdzad du deng 'dir gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod cing gus pa'i me tog 'thor bas/ gru 'dzin gyi spo nas rdzu 'phrul gyis byon/ sgo nas zhugs te gzhal med khang gi dbus kyi pad zla'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dbang phyug bsil zer byed pa'i snying po lta bu zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ ral pa'i zur phud 'od dpag tu med pas brgyan cing*/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis thal mo sbyar ba rgyal ba'i dbang po kun gyi phyag rgya thugs kar gnas pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyang g.yas na bgrang 'phreng dang*/ g.yon chu skyes kyi sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ mdzes sdug gi dpyid/ dar gyi na bzas klubs pa/ kunda 'bar ba lta bu'i 'od zer gyi khongs na rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ g.yas logs su 'phags pa nor bu 'dzin pa gser mdog ral pa dang cod pan can/ gos ser po gyon pa/ rtsa ba'i phyag thal mo sbyar zhing*/ g.yas nor bu dang*/ g.yon chu skyes 'dzin pa/ g.yon logs su 'phags ma yi ge drug ma dkar mo rtsa phyag thal mo sbyar zhing g.yas bgrang 'phreng*/ g.yon chu skyes 'dzin pa/ dbang po'i gzhu'i gos can/ gnyis ka'ang gzhon nu'i lang tsho can/ zur phud gcig pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing sgeg pa dang bcas par skyil krung phyed pas padma la bzhugs par gyur pa gsal btab nas/ mchod pa ni/ rang rang gi phyag rgya dang bcas te/ bla bre gzhal med khang dang gdugs rgyal mtshan// ba dan phye phur lda ldi mchod pa'i dbyibs// kun tu snang bas nam mkha'i khams brgyan pa'i// lha rdzas mchod yon bzang pos mchod par bgyi// oṃ lo ke shwa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/

de nas/ me tog puṣpe/ bdug spos/ dhu pe/ mar me/ ā lo ke dri chab/ gandhe/ zhal zas/ ni widye/ rol mo/ shapta/ dzam bu'i gser las rang byung lte ba zlum// rtsibs stong mu khyud mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba// mkha' la rab 'phags phyogs las rgyal byed pa'i// 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul// oṃ lo ke shwa ra tsakra ratna pra tītstsha swā hā/ thal kar mche ba drug pa zla 'od can// chu zheng phun tshogs yud kyis mkha' lam nas// sa chen rgya mtsho ska rags can bskor ba'i// glang po rin chen/ ha sti ratna/ spu kha rma bya'i mgrin 'dra yid 'ong zhing*// gser gyi rgyan ldan mgyogs pa yid lta bus// tho rangs sa rnams bskor te slar ldog pa'i// rta mchog rin chen// a shwa ratna/ kun tu sngo ba snang byed baiḍūrya// nyin mor byed pa 'od kyis rnam gnon cing*// bsam pa rdzogs byed legs sbyangs cha brgyad pa// nor bu rin chen/ ma ṇi ratna/ 'chi med bu mo bzhin du gzugs mdzes shing*// reg pa mchog gis lus sems bde byed pa// sgyu rtsal kun shes smra mkhas dri bzang gter// btsun mo rin chen/ st+rī ratna/ phur bu'i blo ldan mdzangs shing yid gzhung pa/ khor yug gter gyi 'dod dgur 'dzud byed cing*// des pa snyan pa'i tshig 'byin lha mig can/ khyim bdag rin chen// pu ru ṣa ratna/ sred med bu yi stobs ldan dpa' ba dang*// rtul phod yid la rgyus pa'i don rnams kun// mod la sgrub cing phas rgol med byed pa// blon po rin chen= khaḍga ratna= 'od zer gyis sngo ral gri pags pa 'jam// dga' ba'i nags tshal gos ni yid rjes 'gro// mthu ldan mchil lahwam khang khyim gzhal du med// reg 'jam gzims cha= u pa ratna= pad can dung ltar rab dkar zla bzhin ma// dpal gyi be'u thogs nas bsnyems pa yis// 'phags mchog thugs la dgyes pa'i rgyas btab pa'i// bkra shis dam pas kun tu shis gyur cig

/shrī bat+s+ya/ 'jigs byed kunda'i 'od ldan lus phra ma// gser gyi 'khor lo 'chang ba'i rnam 'gyur gyis// == su warṇa tsakra /'od can mthon mthing bcu drug lang tsho ma// rin chen 'dab brgya bzung nas rol rtsed kyis// == padma kuñdza ra/ rnam rgyal sngo skya 'dod pa'i dbyangs mkhan ma// rgyal mtshan sgreng zhing ga ma kas bcings glus// == kunda dha dza/ mdangs ldan li khri'i rdul 'chang mig yangs ma// mu tig gdugs dkar bskor zhing zur mig mdas// == sitā ta pa tra/ dkar sham mtshams sprin mdog can gzugs mdzes ma// gter gyi bum pas lag brel rtse 'jo yis// == ni dhi gha ṭa/ dri med margata mdangs can dpal ldan ma// g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dung bsnam 'jo sgeg gis// == shaṅkha wart+ta/ yid gzhungs rma bya'i mgrin 'dra dga' bskyed ma// gser gyi nya 'dzin 'gying gzugs glog 'dra bas// == ka na ka mat+s+ya/ bstod pa ni/ oṃ 'jig rten mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten bla ma srid pa gsum gyis bstod pa po// lha yi gtso bo bdud dang tshangs pas bstod pa po// thub pa'i rgyal mchog gdod nas grub par mdzad pa po// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po mchog la phyag 'tshal lo// bder gshegs dpag med sku ste sku gsang 'dzin pa po// bder gshegs snang mtha' yas kyi dbu rgyan 'dzin pa po// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin yi dwags bkres skom sel ba po// phyag g.yon gser gyi padmas rnam par brgyan pa po// dri zhim ral pa'i phreng ba dmar ser 'khyug pa po// zhal ras rgyas pa zla ba lta bur mdzes pa po// spyan gyi padma mchog tu bzang zhing yangs pa po/ kha ba dung ltar rnam dkar 'khril legs ldan pa po// dri med 'od chags mu tig tshom bu 'dzin pa po// mdzes pa'i 'od zer skya rengs dmar pos brgyan pa po// padma'i mtsho ltar phyag ni dngar bar byas pa po// ston ka'i sprin gyi mdog dang ldan zhing gzhon pa po// rin chen mang pos dpung pa gnyis ni brgyan pa po// lo ma'i mchog ltar phyag mthil gzhon zhing 'jam pa po// ri dwags lpags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa po// snyan cha gdu bus sgeg cing rgyan rnams 'chang ba po// dri ma med pa'i padmo'i mchog la gnas pa po// lte ba'i ngos ni padma'i 'dab ltar 'jam pa po// gser gyi ska rags mchog la nor bus spras pa po// sta zur dkris pa'i ras bzang sham thabs 'dzin pa po// thub pa'i mkhyen mchog mtsho chen pha rol phyin pa po// mchog brnyes bsod nams mang po nye bar bsags pa po// rtag tu bde ba'i 'byung gnas rga nad sel ba po// gsum mthar mdzad cing mkha' spyod spyod pa ston pa po// lus can mchog ste bdud dpung 'khrugs las rgyal ba po// gser gyi rkang gdub sgra yis zhabs yid 'ong ba po// tshangs pa'i gnas pa bzhi yis dben par mdzad pa po// ngang pa'i 'gros 'dra glang chen dregs ltar gshegs pa po// yongs rdzogs nye bar bsags shing bstan pa gnyer ba po// 'o ma'i mtsho dang chu yi mtsho las sgrol ba po// gang gis rtag tu tho rangs langs nas gus pa yis// spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po yid la sems byed cing*// bstod pa'i mchog 'di dag cing gsal bar 'don byed na// de ni skyes pa 'am ni bud med yin kyang rung*// 'jig rten 'di 'am ma 'ongs skye ba thams cad du// 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'das dgos pa kun 'grub 'gyur//

zhes tshogs bsag pa'i yan lag mdun bskyed kyi rnal 'byor ro/// / de nas bzlas brjod kyi rnal 'byor la gsum las/ mdun gyi thugs ka'i yi ge la dmigs pa ni/ padma'i 'phreng ba brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ bu mo gtsang mas bkal ba'i skud pa la brgyus pa snying gar gzung*/ oṃ ru tsi ra ma ṇi pra wardha nā ya swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas dbang po lnga dang*/ rlung gi 'jug pa nang du bsdus nas/ mdun gyi lha'i thugs kar zla ba la hrīḥyig oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ gis bskor ba sgra sngags kyi 'phreng ba sems zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gzhi 'phags pa'i sku cig car dmigs nas skyon dang bral bar bzlas so// dbugs mi thub par dbyung ba na/ mi 'gyur ba'i gzhi bdag bskyed gyi lha la dmigs so// skyo na rnam smin gyi lus la ngal 'tsho'o// yang sngar bzhin 'jug ngal na/ sgra sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ sems zla ba la thim de gzhi sangs rgyas la/ de 'khor dang bcas pa rang gi thugs kar bsdu'o// bzlas pa'i 'phro la gnyid dam glal dang sbrid pa dang glo dang lud pa dang 'og rlung dang bshang gci byung na mod la 'phreng ba bzhag ste/ khrus byas slar bzlas brjod kyi dang po nas brtsam par bya'o// yi ge 'bum bzlas na sdig pa 'dag par 'gyur ro// gnyis sam gsum bzlas na rmi lam du mthong bar 'gyur ro// bye ba bzlas na mtshams med pa lnga byas pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/// / gnyis pa rang gi snying ga la dmigs pa ni/ rlung nang du sdud pa'i tshe mdun gyi lha'i thugs ka'i zla ba sngags 'phreng rang gi snying gar bsdu/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe de nyid kyi thugs kar bkod la bzla'o// gtong dus bzhi char thengs gcig dmigs par bya'o// yang na gsum pa sgra la dmigs pa ste/ mi 'gyur gzhi bdag bskyed la bltas nas/ rlung nang du sdud pa'i tshe rang gi lha dang gnyis su med par bsams nas dran pa dang rlung bkag

brjod pa'i sgra tsam la dmigs nas bzla/ phyir 'gro ba'i tshe mdun gyi sgra sems gzhi dang dbyer med pas sgra tsam la dmigs nas bzlas brjod bya'o// de dag ni kun rdzob rnam pa dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes bya la/ bzla tshul gsum po de ni 'dam ka yin no// thun las langs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog/ ces dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dod pa'i don du bsngo'o/// /don dam gnyis su med pa la sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ dang po mer gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ lha'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i rjes de nas/ slar stong pa nyid bsgoms la/ rjes thob lha'i de kho na nyid snying ga'i nang na me 'bar ba'i nang du yi ge'i 'phreng ba gnas pa'i sgra'i bdag nyid la sems bzung srog rtsol bkag ji srid bkres pa med pa la sogs pa'i mtshan ma ma byung gi bar du mnyam par bzhag go /mtshan ma rnyed nas sgra gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin la 'jug ste/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang stong pa nyid bsgoms pa'i rjes thob snying gar zla ba'i nang du me lce'i nang na zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas cung zad gsal btab/ de nas rnam pa spangs sgra tsam la sems 'dzin no// de nas sgra mtha'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug ste/ sgra tsam la sems 'dzin pa de yang spangs nas gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi dbyings kho na la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag par bya'o// tshul 'dis ni don dam pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang mjal bar 'gyur ro// de ltar thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor gsum gyi sgrub thabs/ dpal mo'i rgya gzhung bzhin du/ dpal spos skya 'phags pa rang byung gi lha khang na gnas pa'i bsam gtan pa dag gi kha ton du/ padma dkar pos sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig/
